name: Beijing Jingneng Clean Energy Co., Limited
summary: Beijing Jingneng Clean Energy Co., Limited generates gas-fired power and heat energy, wind power, photovoltaic power, and hydropower in Mainland China and internationally. As of December 31, 2025, it had an installed capacity of 17,437 megawatt (MW), including eight gas-fired cogeneration plants with an installed capacity of 4,835 MW; wind power generation capacity of 7,047 MW; photovoltaic power generation installed capacity of 5, 837 MW; and hydropower installed capacity of 310 MW. The company also offers repair and maintenance; investment management; and finance leasing services. In addition, it sells electricity to local grid companies.
